import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def matrix_multiply_precond (A B : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  A.length > 0 ∧
  A.length ≤ 10 ∧ -- Aligned with Dafny/Verus (10)
  (∀ row, row ∈ A → row.length > 0) ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ A → row.length ≤ 10) ∧
  (∀ i j, i < A.length → j < A.length → (A.getD i []).length = (A.getD j []).length) ∧
  
  -- Value Bounds (ADDED to match references)
  (∀ row, row ∈ A → ∀ val, val ∈ row → val ≤ 100) ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ B → ∀ val, val ∈ row → val ≤ 100) ∧

  B.length > 0 ∧
  B.length ≤ 10 ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ B → row.length > 0) ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ B → row.length ≤ 10) ∧
  (∀ i j, i < B.length → j < B.length → (B.getD i []).length = (B.getD j []).length) ∧
  (A.getD 0 []).length = B.length
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def matrixTab {α : Type} : (n : Nat) → (Nat → α) → List α
  | 0, _ => []
  | n + 1, f => f 0 :: matrixTab n (fun i => f (i + 1))

def matrixEntry (row : List Nat) (col_idx : Nat)
    (B : List (List Nat)) : Nat :=
  (List.range row.length).foldl
    (fun acc k =>
      acc + (row.getD k 0) * ((B.getD k []).getD col_idx 0))
    0
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def matrix_multiply (A B : List (List Nat)) (h_precond : matrix_multiply_precond A B) : List (List Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  matrixTab A.length (fun i =>
    matrixTab (B.getD 0 []).length (fun j =>
      matrixEntry (A.getD i []) j B))
  -- !benchmark @end code

def inner_product (row : List Nat) (col_idx : Nat) (B : List (List Nat)) : Nat :=
  (List.range row.length).foldl (fun acc k => acc + (row.getD k 0) * ((B.getD k []).getD col_idx 0)) 0

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def matrix_multiply_postcond (A B : List (List Nat)) (result : List (List Nat)) (h_precond : matrix_multiply_precond A B) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result.length = A.length ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ result → row.length = (B.getD 0 []).length) ∧
  (∀ i j, i < result.length → j < (result.getD 0 []).length →
    (result.getD i []).getD j 0 = inner_product (A.getD i []) j B)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
@[simp]
theorem matrixTab_length {α : Type} (n : Nat) (f : Nat → α) :
    (matrixTab n f).length = n := by
  induction n generalizing f with
  | zero =>
      simp [matrixTab]
  | succ n ih =>
      simp [matrixTab, ih]

theorem matrixTab_getD {α : Type} (n : Nat) (f : Nat → α)
    (i : Nat) (d : α) (h : i < n) :
    (matrixTab n f).getD i d = f i := by
  induction n generalizing f i with
  | zero =>
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          simp [matrixTab]
      | succ i =>
          have hi : i < n := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h
          have hrec :=
            ih (f := fun k => f (k + 1)) (i := i) hi
          simpa [matrixTab] using hrec

theorem matrixTab_mem {α : Type} (n : Nat) (f : Nat → α) (x : α)
    (h : x ∈ matrixTab n f) :
    ∃ i, i < n ∧ x = f i := by
  induction n generalizing f with
  | zero =>
      simp [matrixTab] at h
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [matrixTab, List.mem_cons] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · subst x
        exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ n, rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ :=
          ih (f := fun k => f (k + 1)) h
        refine ⟨i + 1, by omega, ?_⟩
        simpa using hxi

theorem matrixEntry_eq_inner_product
    (row : List Nat) (col_idx : Nat) (B : List (List Nat)) :
    matrixEntry row col_idx B = inner_product row col_idx B := by
  rfl
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem matrix_multiply_postcond_satisfied (A B : List (List Nat))
    (h_precond : matrix_multiply_precond A B) :
    matrix_multiply_postcond A B (matrix_multiply A B h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  constructor
  · simp [matrix_multiply]
  constructor
  · intro row hrow
    change row ∈
      matrixTab A.length (fun i =>
        matrixTab (B.getD 0 []).length (fun j =>
          matrixEntry (A.getD i []) j B)) at hrow
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := matrixTab_mem _ _ _ hrow
    simp
  · intro i j hi hj
    have hiA : i < A.length := by
      simpa [matrix_multiply] using hi

    have hApos : 0 < A.length := h_precond.1

    change j <
      ((matrixTab A.length (fun i =>
        matrixTab (B.getD 0 []).length (fun j =>
          matrixEntry (A.getD i []) j B))).getD 0 []).length at hj

    rw [matrixTab_getD A.length
      (fun i =>
        matrixTab (B.getD 0 []).length (fun j =>
          matrixEntry (A.getD i []) j B))
      0 [] hApos] at hj

    have hjB : j < (B.getD 0 []).length := by
      simpa using hj

    change
      ((matrixTab A.length (fun i =>
        matrixTab (B.getD 0 []).length (fun j =>
          matrixEntry (A.getD i []) j B))).getD i []).getD j 0 =
        inner_product (A.getD i []) j B

    rw [matrixTab_getD A.length
      (fun i =>
        matrixTab (B.getD 0 []).length (fun j =>
          matrixEntry (A.getD i []) j B))
      i [] hiA]

    rw [matrixTab_getD (B.getD 0 []).length
      (fun j => matrixEntry (A.getD i []) j B)
      j 0 hjB]

    exact matrixEntry_eq_inner_product (A.getD i []) j B
  -- !benchmark @end proof
